name: @ed/mobile
description: Android and iOS shell for Eldritch Dynasty. Owns native lifecycle and device services; owns no game rules.

scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare-web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run prepare-web && cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run build --workspace @ed/client && npm run sync:android && cap run android
scripts.ios:build: npm run build --workspace @ed/client && npm run sync:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios: npm run build --workspace @ed/client && npm run sync:ios && cap run ios
